chapter: Blanton, Los Angeles and Art Tatum
title: Rehearsals with Tatum and Tiny Grimes
summary: The trio rehearsed often with guitarist Tiny Grimes on a variety of ballads, pop tunes and fast numbers Tatum chose.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Now, did you -- did he like to work out the kinds of progressions that you all were to play or did he just -- did you all rehearse much or did he just --
Yes, we rehearsed quite a bit. Along with myself, Tiny Grimes was on guitar. And we had quite a few rehearsals, every chance we got.
You rehearsed a lot. What kinds of things did you work out in rehearsals, do you remember?

Well, Art would pick out the numbers, which there was a variety of things. Some of the numbers that we worked out, which we record quite a few times also, and slow numbers, you know, ballads and pop tunes and fast tunes, real fast, I mean. We had quite a variety of things that we worked out on.
